Done — closing as completed. All three items landed:

- **Item 1** (objectql server-side option-value enforcement) was already on `main` via **objectstack-ai/framework#2915** — `evaluateOptionVisibility` in the rule-validator (merged record + `current_user`, `{ field, code: 'invalid_option' }`, multi-select element-wise, fail-open on a broken predicate), `needsPriorRecord` extended, reusing `@objectstack/formula`. Covered by `rule-validator.option-visibility.test.ts` (15/15: out-of-set rejected, in-set accepted, role-gated reject/accept, broken-predicate fail-open, UPDATE prior-record fetch). No re-implementation was needed.
- **Item 2** (app-showcase fixture) — **objectstack-ai/framework#3006** (merged): a new `showcase_cascade` object with the `country → province` cascade + a role-gated `tier.restricted` option, wired into the Showcase app's Data Model nav.
- **Item 3** (objectui live e2e) — **#2562** (merged): `e2e/live/cascading-options.spec.ts` — asserts the client offered-set re-filter + cascade-clear and the server rejection via the data API; excluded from the default/CI run (`testIgnore: ['**/live/**']`), opt-in via `pnpm test:e2e:live`.

One faithful deviation from the sketch: the role gate uses `'admin' in current_user.positions` (not `…roles`) — `positions` is what `buildEvalUser` actually binds as `current_user`, and it matches the spec's own `SelectOption.visibleWhen` example.

Verified live against a fresh backend: `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_cascade` → **400** `invalid_option` for `{country:'us',province:'zj'}` and for `{tier:'restricted'}` (the seeded admin holds no `admin` position), **201** for `{country:'cn',province:'zj'}`; `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_cascade` serves the per-option `visibleWhen` to the client.
